entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to start a return for an item I purchased a couple of months ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Grip cycling shoes. Is that the correct item?
That's the one. The cycling shoes just aren't working out for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than ten miles.
Ouch, blisters are definitely no fun and can ruin a good ride. I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, it looks like you received them 68 days ago.
That sounds about right. I really tried to make them work.

I appreciate you giving them a fair shot. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file right now.
Okay, a full refund is great. Thank you for making that easy. I do have one more question, though.
Of course, what is it?

Well, since I did have to deal with the discomfort and the blisters for a couple of months, and I'll still need to buy another pair of shoes, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe 15% off?

I understand where you're coming from, but our policy is to provide a full refund in these situations, which covers the cost of the item. We aren't able to offer additional discounts or credits on top of the approved refund.
I see. Can't do 10% even? Just for the trouble?

I'm afraid not. The full refund is the complete resolution we can offer for a return. The label I sent is active, so you can pack the shoes up and drop them off at your convenience. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Alright, fair enough. Had to ask. Thanks again for your help with the return, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
